# Indikator 4a1

Measures the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients with indication for anticoagulation treatment who receive treatment 1 year after index date, with a standard of ≥90% compliance across Danish regions and health clusters.

## Mentions

- Page 26: "Indikator 4a1: Andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, med indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling 1 år efter indeksdato" [^src1]

## Relationships

- [[danmark|Danmark]] — measures-compliance-in [^src1]. Evidence: "Indikator 4a1 reports 89,1% compliance for Danmark" (Page 26)

## Claims

- For Indikator 4a1 (1-year anticoagulation treatment), Danmark achieved 89,1% compliance (95% CI: 88,5-89,7) based on 9.507 / 10.668 patients ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[danmark|Danmark]])
- For Indikator 4a1, Region Hovedstaden achieved 88,8% compliance (95% CI: 87,6-90,0) based on 2.460 / 2.770 patients ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]])
- For Indikator 4a1, Region Sjælland achieved 88,7% compliance (95% CI: 87,1-90,1) based on 1.636 / 1.845 patients ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[sjaelland|Sjælland]])
- For Indikator 4a1, Region Syddanmark achieved 88,2% compliance (95% CI: 86,9-89,5) based on 2.177 / 2.467 patients ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[syddanmark|Syddanmark]])
- For Indikator 4a1, Region Midtjylland achieved 89,2% compliance (95% CI: 87,9-90,4) based on 2.114 / 2.370 patients ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[midtjylland|Midtjylland]])
- For Indikator 4a1, Region Nordjylland achieved 92,1% compliance (95% CI: 90,4-93,6) based on 1.120 / 1.216 patients, meeting the ≥90% standard ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[nordjylland|Nordjylland]])
